method.resolution: Paths are relative to each manifest directory, preserving spaces; only paths resolving inside publication repository are read.
method.syntax: Strict GNU text/binary checksum format, optional GNU filename escaping, or BSD SHA256 tagged format; blank/comment lines reported separately; any unparsed entry is a failure.
method.oldVersionEntries: Old-version files are checked when explicitly listed; no inferred removal or coverage requirement.

limitations: Validates only the files actually named by each existing manifest, not inventory completeness.
This is checksum consistency evidence, not new gameplay, video decoding, cryptographic signature, or physical-device validation.
